name: decisions_write

ops.description: Operations, one flat object each, run in order. A field marked [ops: ...] applies only to the ops named.

reason.description: Why the user is needed, 1 to 500 characters. [ops: escalate]

option.description: Key of the chosen option. [ops: answer]

text.description: Free-form answer, at most 1000 characters; freeform classes only. [ops: answer]

rationale.description: Why this answer, at most 1000 characters. [ops: answer]

decidedBy.description: Who decided: user or director. Absent: derived from the caller; a claim the credential contradicts is refused. [ops: answer]

links.description: Up to 10 {kind, ref} pointers; kind is item, note, doc, commit or url. [ops: answer]

idempotencyKey.description: Optional client key (1-128 chars). Resending the same op with the same key returns the stored result.

atomic.description: true: the first failing op rolls back the whole batch. Default false: each op commits on its own.

describe.description: true: return each operation's parameters and errors; nothing runs.

description: Ack, delegate, escalate, answer and withdraw decisions. Each op needs a root in scope and the decide capability (withdraw: runs). Only the answerers of a decision's class ack, answer or delegate it; the director also escalates a human-only decision. Result: the decision. Call with describe:true for parameters and errors.
